gist.headline: Lumara joins the garden
gist.blurb: Lumara has landed in the app garden: a desktop home for Pollinations image generation, model picking, and artistic styling. The pixels can now live a little closer to your keyboard.
gist.summary: Added Lumara to the Pollinations app directory, highlighting a desktop application for generating images with Pollinations models and optional artistic styles.
gist.impact: People looking for a desktop-first image workflow can now discover Lumara directly through the Pollinations community app listings.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Lumara as a cozy desktop creative studio: a retro computer running an image-generation app with a small gallery of pastel pixel landscapes and model/style controls. Polli wears a tiny artist beret and warmly helps arrange image cards beside code-plants and blooming flowers, representing a new community desktop tool joining the ecosystem.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art desktop studio where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny painter's beret, hovers beside a chunky retro computer displaying a simple image-generation gallery and style palette; pixel flowers and code-plants bloom around the desk, with lime green (#ecf874) prominent across the screen glow and garden pots. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with subtle pixel-font text reading "LUMARA".
